heading: “Member of the House” defined
lead: As used in section 5324 of this title the phrase “Member of the House” shall mean a Representative, Representative-elect, Delegate, Delegate-elect, Resident Commissioner, or Resident Commissioner-elect.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 92d of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Jan. 3, 1935, see section 4 of act Aug. 21, 1935, set out as a note under section 5324 of this title.
